title: Hard object found in nostril during 2001 nasal surgery

tellings.quote: Well, uh, in 2001, I believe it was, um, I was having breathing problems. I had a deviated septum. So, I finally had some nasal surgery.

plain: A man named Richard, a former guard at a nuclear missile site who says aliens abducted him, says that in 2001 he had trouble breathing because of a crooked wall inside his nose and finally had surgery for it. According to Richard, a hard object turned up in his nostril during the operation, and he tells it as a sign that something may have been put inside his body.
